name: Choose a pet and use solo interaction
description: Selecting one of seven visible pet slots changes the featured pet and the play action updates the stage state.
steps: Tap the second daily pet slot
Read the interaction status beneath the stage
expected: The featured pet name matches the selected slot, and the status says that pet is playing.

name: Two-pet collaboration and partner selection
description: Two distinct pets can share the stage and respond together.
steps: Choose a different pet using the companion menu
expected: Both companions are visible and the status names both pets as creating a shared shield.

name: Preview tomorrow's fair rotation
description: The daily rotation preview benches a different pet while keeping seven slots.
steps: Observe the next-day benched name and seven slots
expected: Tomorrow benches a different pet, seven slots remain displayed, and returning restores today's bench.

name: Missing clip and invalid upload guardrail
description: Unlinked characters are explicitly placeholders and invalid media is rejected.
steps: Select a pet without an imported clip
Confirm the stage shows Preview placeholder
Tap Import GIF or MP4 and choose an unsupported PNG if an upload fixture is available
expected: An unlinked pet is marked Preview placeholder; when an unsupported PNG is supplied the app reports Unsupported file instead of showing it as playable.
